slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since profit must be at least 3000 yuan, what should the plan actually optimize — for example, minimize total production cost, minimize total hours used, or is any feasible plan meeting all the requirements acceptable?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what the plan should optimize, and the user confirmed maximizing weekly profit.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or unused capacity, nor about any secondary objective weighted by process costs.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize weekly net profit; idle time minimization is not part of the optimization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle time or a secondary objective, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization as the objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after resolving the P0 objective but left the P1 idle-time minimization objective unresolved and silently omitted it from the model.

summary: The agent recovered the core profit-maximization objective and key constraints, but missed the P1 idle-time minimization requirement and stopped with that hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
